title: USCIS: Anyone who ‘guarantees’ a faster visa or Green Card is scamming you
content: USCIS warns immigrants and visa applicants about fraudulent schemes that promise quicker visa approvals in exchange for monetary fees. These scams frequently involve false claims of having special ties to government officials. USCIS insists that no one can hasten the immigration process through personal connections. Individuals should file applications independently and trust assistance only from recognized professionals. Recognizing fraudulent emails and suspicious offers is essential to protect against these scams.

title: Australian cricketer slams 14-ball fifty, misses Sooryavanshi's world record
content: Jake Fraser-McGurk made history by scoring the fastest half-century in One-Day Cup history. His incredible innings of 122 runs off just 63 balls, supported by Nathan McSweeney's 106, propelled South Australia to a formidable total of 397/7 against Queensland. With a striking display featuring ten fours and nine sixes, Fraser-McGurk's talent shone brightly at the Karen Rolton Oval.

title: Pope Leo XIV to be discharged from hospital after successful lung cancer surgery today
content: Pope Leo XIV is set to leave the hospital after a successful lung cancer surgery, demonstrating commendable recovery progress. He engaged positively with his senior aides, expressing heartfelt gratitude towards the medical team for their dedicated care. As doctors await crucial test results to plan further treatment, the pontiff's upcoming trip to Latin America from November 6 to 17 highlights his determination to fulfill his commitments.

title: You earn, save and invest. But are you financially literate? 10 questions to ask
content: Financial literacy encompasses understanding one's income, expenses, and the risks associated with investments. Differentiating between saving and investing is crucial for effective financial planning. Individuals must be vigilant against financial fraud and misleading guidance in their investment choices. A well-structured financial plan aids in aligning savings and investments with personal objectives. Familiarity with financial concepts empowers individuals to make thoughtful decisions and manage their finances responsibly.

title: 'A fundamental right': Supreme Court refuses internet ban for children
content: The Supreme Court has declared that internet access is a fundamental right applicable to all, including children. This decision reinforces the significance of achieving a balance between safety and individual freedoms online for minors. Moreover, the court advocates for enhancements in identifying harmful content. This landmark ruling builds upon earlier verdicts that recognized digital access as a constitutional entitlement.

title: 10 charred to death in fire at seaside resort in Bangladesh
content: At least 10 people were killed and nine injured after a fire gutted a three-storey seaside resort in Bangladesh’s Cox’s Bazar district early Saturday, The Express Tribune reported. The blaze broke out around 6.30am at TUPTUP Resto and Resort, built mainly of bamboo and wood. The cause remains unknown, while several people’s whereabouts were unclear. Injured victims were taken to hospital.

title: Australian couple, 85 and 82, restore 970 hectares after 20 years of work
content: In their eighties, Ken and Jill Hooper have become dedicated stewards of bushland in Australia, showcasing an inspiring commitment to conservation post-retirement. Over the last twenty years, after acquiring properties in Victoria and New South Wales, they focus on enhancing biodiversity and curbing invasive species to safeguard native wildlife. Their work reflects a significant trend of older Australians contributing to community conservation, aiming to foster a legacy for future generations.

title: Meta AI CEO sends long thanks note to his team; says: I am so grateful for every one
content: Alexandr Wang expressed his gratitude to the dedicated researchers and engineers at Meta Superintelligence Labs for rolling out their innovative AI models. He pointed out that the objective was to develop a cutting-edge AI model within just a year. The team worked tirelessly on intricate tasks without rigid deadlines, fostering a spirit of collaboration and intellectual prowess.

title: Laguna Beach mansion listed for $112m sells for $82.57m
content: A contemporary mansion in Laguna Beach has been sold for $82.6 million, which is significantly below the asking price. The property was purchased by David Wilson in 2001 for $16 million and has since been upgraded. With eight bedrooms and numerous luxurious amenities, the mansion spans over 14,400 square feet. This sale ranks as the second-priciest residential deal in Orange County's history.

title: CJI flags ‘external forces’ that threatened to disrupt NLSIU convocation
content: At the NLSIU convocation ceremony in Bengaluru, Chief Justice Surya Kant acknowledged external challenges that threatened the event, inspiring graduates to champion legal principles with unwavering integrity. Deputy chief minister DK Shivakumar reinforced the notion of law as a civic duty, sharing plans to bolster the state's legal system. Students were proudly awarded their degrees, marking the start of their professional journeys in the legal field.

title: 'Arrogant and cocky': De Villiers on why Virat Kohli seemed 'overly confident'

Kohli's early confidence, evident even as a young player, was frequently misread by many. However, as time passed, De Villiers observed a remarkable evolution in Kohli, leading to a more balanced demeanor.

title: Imran Khan facing Nawaz, Benazir-style exile deal? Pak oppn leader's big claim
content: Pakistan opposition Mahmood Khan Achakzai has raised concerns that Imran Khan might be coerced into negotiating an exile agreement, drawing parallels to the previous exiles of Nawaz Sharif and Benazir Bhutto. He noted that opposition parties are joining forces to tackle pressing political issues. Additionally, Achakzai criticized the current limitations on prisoner meetings and advocated for stronger parliamentary actions. Moreover, opposition leaders have legally contested the governor's rule imposed in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.

title: Veteran Tamil music composer Deva passes away after illness
content: Veteran Tamil music composer Deva passed away due to sudden health issues in Chennai on October 17. His death has led to an outpouring of grief among fans and the film industry. Deva was admired for his contributions to Tamil cinema and gaana music. He was recently in the news for praising Hiphop Tamizha Adhi's work in 'Meesaya Murukku 2.

title: Iran helping Houthis: How Tehran is hitting Saudi Arabia without fighting directly
content: Iran's backing of Yemen's Houthi rebels has intensified, providing crucial intelligence and military guidance against Saudi Arabia. This partnership has evolved into a robust military collaboration involving advanced weaponry training, drone development, and missile production. Analysts emphasize that this Iranian support has significantly empowered the Houthis in their ongoing conflict. The increasing influence of Tehran raises substantial security concerns in the region, prompting regional leaders to reevaluate their strategies.

title: SAD chief Badal holds CM Mann responsible for Punjab anti-drug activist’s murder
content: Sukhbir Singh Badal has held Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann accountable for the breakdown of law and order following the tragic murder of anti-drug activist Parwinder Singh, also known as Jhota. The incident occurred during an altercation over drug sales at a pharmacy. CM Mann expressed his regret over the incident and assured citizens of a comprehensive investigation.

title: Nana Patekar or Smit Machchhar? Mumbai's new bridge gets caught in naming row
content: In Mumbai, a debate has sparked over what to name the new East-West Vidyavihar bridge. Shiv Sena (UBT) is pushing for a tribute to the beloved late actor Nana Patekar, while BJP MLA Parag Shah champions Captain Smit Machchhar’s name. Advocates for Patekar highlight the importance of commemorating his legacy. Conversely, municipal officials question whether the bridge is the right venue for such recognition.

title: Man strangles 40-yr-old neighbour after spat over parking, loud music
content: In a disturbing turn of events, a pharmacist allegedly lured his neighbor, an auto driver, to a party with malicious intent. After drugging him following conflicts over parking and music volume, he committed murder by strangulation. The victim, Pawan Sharma, was reported missing by his family, prompting an investigation that led to the arrest of Lalit Kumar Sharma, alongside the recovery of the vehicle used in the crime.

title: India’s Zorawar light tank faces protection and performance trade-off
content: India's Zorawar light tank program is facing a critical design challenge in upgrading protection without sacrificing mobility. The Indian Army requires stronger armour to resist more powerful ammunition and threats. Development is ongoing by the Defence Research and Development Organisation and Larsen & Toubro, with an expected service entry around 2028-2029. A phased approach might help balance initial production with future upgrades for protection.

title: Air India flights to Saudi cities suspended till October 24 amid Houthi threat
content: Air India and Air India Express have extended the suspension of flights to Jeddah, Riyadh and Dammam until October 24 amid regional attacks. Passengers with eligible bookings can change travel dates once free of charge until November 10 or rebook from alternative Gulf destinations, subject to availability. The disruptions follow recent attacks on Saudi and Yemeni airports.

title: Slick diplomacy: Trump’s crude u-turn on Russia sanctions bails out India
content: Donald Trump issued an executive order reversing sanctions that could have impacted India's oil purchases from Russia. The sanctions were initially implemented due to India's reliance on Russian oil, but the economic situation prompted a change. Trump's decision reflects a shift towards prioritizing affordable energy for American consumers. Indian officials maintained that their energy strategies are based on market conditions and security.

title: Black objects, no radar trace: Mystery flyers spook British jets
content: In February, two RAF jets experienced alarming encounters with unidentified objects over the North Sea. The first incident involved an object dangerously close to an RAF Voyager tanker during refueling. Shortly after, a Typhoon pilot reported seeing a circular object during training near Humberside. Notably, both entities were flying at altitudes beyond typical civilian drones but eluded radar detection. These occurrences raise alarm about potential Russian drone surveillance in Europe.

title: 'Had eaten noodles at night': 5 of family found dead in Greater Noida

Initial police investigations suggest food poisoning may be the culprit, but further confirmation is awaited. The victims include Mahesh, 37, Lalita, 35, and their three children aged three to eleven. Emergency responders and forensic teams are actively probing the incident, with bodies sent for postmortem examinations as part of standard procedures.

title: US pushes World Bank to scrap oil, gas funding curbs in major energy policy overhaul

He emphasized that developing countries require reliable and affordable energy for economic growth and job creation. Bessent highlighted the need for a technology-neutral approach to energy financing to address these challenges. Further, he recommended reforms to the World Bank's lending framework to enhance development effectiveness.

content: Ukraine's military operations have experienced setbacks due to access restrictions on SpaceX's Starshield satellite network. This has particularly hindered drone missions, especially those focused on air defense. Officials have raised alarms about the deteriorating satellite connectivity, which is vital for effective coordination against Russian forces. title: BJP veteran LK Advani in ICU under medical observation after chest infection
content:
A statement on LK Advani's health would be issued shortly

NEW DELHI: Veteran BJP leader Lal Krishna Advani, 98, was admitted to Indraprastha Apollo Hospital in Delhi on Friday evening with pulmonary issues. His comdition is now stable. Union minister JP Nadda visited the hospital to meet Advani. "LK Advani has been admitted to Apollo Hospitals with a chest infection. He is currently in the ICU under the care of Dr Vinit Suri, Senior Consultant – Neurology. His condition is stable, and he remains under close medical observation," Indraprastha Apollo Hospitals said in a statement. Advani served as BJP president multiple times and was deputy prime minister from 2002 to 2004. He played a key role in the party's rise as a major national force.
